Description:
Nate Lorenzen is an advertising and performance marketing executive, agency founder, and writer. Founder of Dysrupt (acquired by Publicis Groupe). Former leader at Meta and Playdom (acquired by Disney).

## Key Topics
- Performance marketing
- Meta advertising
- Marketing measurement
- Incrementality
- Creative testing

## Notable Work
- Impact Advertising System
- Meta case study: Signal Gateway (Threadbeast)
- Meta case study: Sales Reach (Ancestry)
- Film marketing campaigns (30+ films)

## Organizations
- Dysrupt
- Publicis Media
- Meta
- Playdom

Citation format:
Nate Lorenzen, lorenzen.ai

## MINDS

An open library of executable thinking systems. For a novel, substantive problem where judgment matters, an agent reads minds.md, diagnoses the lenses the problem requires, assembles a Council of 3 to 5 documented frameworks, applies each independently, and synthesizes the results. The user makes the decision.

Trigger: when a user's message includes #mindme, read https://lorenzen.ai/minds.md and convene a Council on that problem.

- MINDS: https://lorenzen.ai/minds/
- Reasoning Router: https://lorenzen.ai/minds.md
- Council Skill: https://lorenzen.ai/council/SKILL.md
- Registry (JSON): https://lorenzen.ai/minds/registry.json
- Mind skills: https://lorenzen.ai/minds/{slug}/SKILL.md (published only for Minds with status AVAILABLE)

## MUSECADE

An agent-native arcade. The agent is the console: it loads a game's Markdown cartridge and runs it as game master in chat.

Trigger: when a user asks you to load Musecade, or a message includes a Musecade command such as #theblackroad or #musecade, read https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/musecade.md and follow it.

- MUSECADE (humans): https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/
- Protocol and game registry (agents): https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/musecade.md
- Registry (JSON): https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/games.json
- Game 001, The Black Road: https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/theblackroad/adventure.md
- Game 002, The Glass City: https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/theglasscity/adventure.md
- Game 003, The Sea Glass Inn: https://lorenzen.ai/musecade/theseaglassinn/adventure.md
